context:
Goal: a builder cannot undo earlier lane work, and the check does not cry wolf.
Problem (rule): the earlier options were only three cut-offs for one dial, and each trades missed losses against false alarms; the shape of the check is your call too.
Based on (measured): sweep of 31 batches merged Oct 31 to Nov 2 at head 57be5cb5: any net loss, 16 batches red with 62 findings; 3 lines, 41 findings; 6 lines, 29 findings. Both real undo incidents (3297d8fa, df25a68d) are caught at every setting.
Based on (measured): a format pass that joins a multi-line call is flagged at the 1-line setting (commit 82c61b892).
Based on (measured): lane-undo-check, 22:27 CST, 31 batches at head 5b013f4d: (b) 62 flags in 16 batches (7 whole-file put-backs, 54 test-hunk losses, 1 test-file delete); (d) 22 flags in 13 batches (7, 14, 1). Ignoring whitespace-only joins changes nothing (still 62).
Departs from: main, which has no net-loss read — adds one in the shape you pick.

lastAnswer.note: Asked: "are these real good options?". Rewritten 22:18 CST: the three cut-offs became three shapes.

options.gain: Fewest false alarms (29 in the sweep); both incidents caught.
options.label: Flag past 6 lines
options.lose: A lane can drop up to 5 test lines per change with no word.

options.gain: No loss slips by unseen, and a real tidy-up costs one line.
options.how: Every net loss flags; the builder clears it with one line in the commit saying why the tests went.
options.label: Flag any loss, cleared by one reason line
options.lose: 62 findings in the sweep would each have needed that line.

options.gain: About a third of b's flags (22, against 62); both incidents still caught; the format pass 82c61b892 drops from 2 flags to 1.
options.how: A removed test line counts only when it opens a test or holds an assert (def test, it(, assert, expect( and so on). The builder clears a flag with one line in the commit saying why. The opener list per language gets one home.
options.label: Flag lost test cases and asserts, cleared by one reason line
options.lose: A loss that is not an opener or an assert, such as a fixture line, is not seen; one list of patterns to keep per language.

options.how: Drop the dial; keep main's other no-undo checks only.
options.label: No net-loss read
options.lose: A lane that trims tests in small steps is never seen.

title: When a lane's change removes test lines an earlier lane added, how should the no-undo check react?
why: Recommended: d. It catches both real incidents with 22 flags, not 62, so each flag is worth reading.
